lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Two Annihilios have been confirmed destroyed.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Only one remains.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... You managed to shoot down two of those missiles while holding back all those Raptures at the same time?

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: Yeah, Matis and the Ark Rangers did.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The Ark is pretty impressive.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op
lines.text: It's amazing is what it is.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Captain.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Could you position us below the missile?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... Come again?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Whoa. You're gonna aim right for the power core, aren't you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're very perceptive.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That's right. I can shoot it straight from below.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No need to go through the hassle of stripping off all that armor.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: Wow ★ That's not something that just anyone would try to do.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Perhaps, but I can do it.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Yeah, let's do it! We'll dive beneath that Heretic and match her rate of descent!
*Whoosh!*
Dorothy watches the scenery outside the window tilt sharply.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hmm. It looks like we're making a steep turn. But I don't feel anything.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: That's right! ♥ We retrofitted the bridge with active gimbal technology.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: You can even drink tea in here without worrying about spilling ★

lines.speaker: cielo
lines.text: Speaking of, would you like a cup?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Just like last time, I'll have it when I get back.

lines.speaker: cielo
lines.text: Hehe, all right! I'll have a warm cup of plum blossom tea waiting for you.
Dorothy looks up from the deck of the Wings of Victory.
Annihilio is plummeting down at breakneck speed.
Dorothy raises her arm and aims at the sky.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Look at you, Dorothy, fighting here like this.
*Boom!*
A beam of light erupts from Dorothy's gun barrel,
and pierces straight through Annihilio.
Annihilio's posture falters. The light and flames spewing from her are completely extinguished.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: ... That was amazing. You hit the power source with a single shot.

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: But don't forget that there's a separate main body.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Right. But if the warhead falls to the ground, the chemical payload will—

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's okay. I shot through the detonator while I was at it.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: ... "Amazing" doesn't begin to do you justice.

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: No kidding.
Annihilio continues to fall.
Dorothy waits. She waits for Annihilio's armor to peel away and expose the main body.
A piece of metal clanks as it flies off.
Then another, and another...
All of Annihilio's armor is stripped away.
Then, from within,
Monks with red eyes come pouring down.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: sky_op_r
lines.text: N-Nikkes...?!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What the...?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now then...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Shall we make some new friends?
Dorothy watches the red-eyed monks pouring down.
There are 42 in total.
Their eyes are red. They are corrupted.
Nikkes who have succumbed to corruption and can never return.
She has to shoot them.
But she hesitates for just a brief moment.
Taking advantage of the opening in that flash of an instant,
one of the monks rushes forward,
and thrusts the thorn in her hand directly into Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hngh...!
*Thud, thud, thud!*
The monks land on the deck.
Some of their gazes shift towards the bridge.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Agh...!
Dorothy fires at them,
one after another after another.
The red-eyed monks fall.
They vanish, emitting a blue light.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No one leave the bridge under any circumstances!
Dorothy runs.
She pushes her way through all of the red-eyed monks.
Fortunately, their individual combat capabilities are not that high.
She feels confident she can defeat them without much trouble.
However...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Hah.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Haha... hahaha.
Dorothy lets out a hollow, empty laugh,
and then points her weapon at the monks and shoots.
The monks are completely annihilated.
They leave behind no trace, almost as if they never even existed.
Dorothy gasps as she struggles to breathe.
Her body is tingling.
Her vision is tinged with red.
She looks down at her hands.
They are trembling ever so slightly.

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Dorothy! Dorothy!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Wait! I'm coming right now!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Don't!

lines.speaker: sora_op_c
lines.text: Doro... thy.

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: But... the corruption...

lines.speaker: sky_op_r
lines.text: Divert! Head back to the Ark!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Stop! You can't bring a corrupted Nikke back to the Ark!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: B-but...
Dorothy's breathing grows ragged.
The symptoms are progressing rapidly, more so than she's ever seen before.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... It must be... a modified strain... for war...
Dorothy lifts her head.
She sees the vast surface stretching out beyond the deck.
After a few moments,
Dorothy pulls a pistol from her pocket and places it below her chin.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Still... I'm glad...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I was able to forgive...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Stop!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Stop! Don't pull that trigger! I'm going to kill you if you do!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Comman...der...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Run, Dorothy! Run!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Run as far away as you can!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Commander, the corruption will erase me...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Shut up and run! Get away from there!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I promise you right now...!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I'll bring you back!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I promise!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We have plenty of options!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: So don't shoot! Put the gun down, damn it!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Put it down! Don't shoot!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Commander.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We'll find you...!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: We'll find you and bring you back!

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That's a promise, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Believe in me.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Believe in me, your Commander.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Make sure you bring me back.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... I will. I swear.
Dorothy tosses the pistol aside.
She runs towards the edge of the deck,
and throws herself into the sky.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... Wait for me, Dorothy. I'll come find you.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Yes, Commander.
She disappears from view.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Dorothy...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Arrrgggh!
*Bam!*
Andersen slams his fist down onto the table.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Damn it! Damn the Queen, that bitch!

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Calm down. You still haven't fully recovered, so don't get too worked up.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I don't care.
*Bam! Bam! Crash!*
Andersen goes on a rampage as he sends furniture flying—chairs, the table, and whatever else he can get off the ground.
Watching Andersen, Burningum feels both shocked and worried.
After a while, Andersen stops his outburst.
Burningum gets into position,
ready to catch Andersen the moment he collapses.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... What the?
Burningum stares intently at Andersen from behind.
Something is wrong.
Burningum stares even more intently at Andersen, trying to identify what feels off.
Suddenly, he figures it out.
Andersen's breathing hasn't faltered in the slightest.
His shoulders aren't heaving, and he's not breathing raggedly.
Burningum freezes.
Silence fills the briefing room.
*Clang!*
Something metallic drops to the floor.
For a moment, Burningum feels as if his heart dropped along with it.
He looks down.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's...!
He sees the thing that had been restraining his hero,
that cursed mechanical device, now lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Andersen... Your... life support device... just fell...

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... I don't need it anymore.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I just get that feeling.
Andersen turns around.
Burningum takes a look at Andersen and immediately takes a few steps back.
He rubs his eyes.
His physical appearance hasn't changed,
but there's now an energy emanating from his face and posture, a certain vitality.
Standing before Burningum is the man who was both his hero and his ideal,
the legendary Commander.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: ... Let's go up.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: To the surface.
Light illuminates the black space.
Marian embraces the core and the gene.
She entrusts her consciousness to memories that are becoming clearer.
My name?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Yes. I've got to call you something, don't I?
Uh... well.
Everyone used to call me No. 7.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: So should I call you No. 7? That feels weird.
Yeah, it does feel a little weird.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: You said your dream was to become a commander, right?
Yeah.
I made a promise with that child.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: ... What child?
... Hmm. I'm sorry. I can't really remember.
But...
I remember she was incredibly dear to me.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Then, I will call you Commander.
Er, I'm not so sure about that.
It'd be kind of embarrassing when I just graduated from the military academy yesterday.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: So what? It's just the two of us.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: It should be fine, right?
... All right. "Commander" it is.
Now, what should I call you?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Maria...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: ... Wow.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You're so beautiful.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You really look like a Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you.
Marian gazes at the sky outside the window.
There is a radiance in her eyes that sparkles, as though the whole world is in her embrace.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: This time...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I promise to keep you safe.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Wait. Everyone, hold on.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What's wrong, Levi?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... It's moving.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The Lift.
I turn my head and look back.
The monumental Lift is wriggling, covered in Dark Matter.
... It's enough to warp your sense of reality, seeing something that massive moving like liquid.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... What's it doing?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-you don't think it's...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The way it's moving... Yeah.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's transforming.
Suddenly from the Lift,
a shockwave erupts together with black light.
I squeeze my eyes shut,
and then open them a moment later.
The colossal Lift is gone, now vanished without a trace.
Instead, filling my entire field of vision,
is something so enormous that I can't even take it all in at once.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... She's mocking us.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Indeed, she flouts us downright.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You know, I don't think I've ever been this angry in my entire life.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Nor I...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... I'm going to kill her.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I swear, I'm going to kill her!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I will kill the Queen!
Towering before us is the statue of the Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... It's moving.
The statue of the Goddess of Victory moves.
It changes directions,
and then slowly starts to advance forward.
The ground trembles, and the air itself seems to shriek.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The Queen...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's heading to the Ark.
